text:
li: starting a small canary for v4-int4-compact today. want eyeballs on the thermostat+fallback rules before we open routing.

li: plan: 1.5% total, split by request type (interactive vs batch) and by token-length buckets. batch long tails get tiny share.

eval_bot: quick staging smoke (n=1800): overall MRR -0.9%, latency p95 +75ms, hallucination +0.2pp vs v3.2-fp16. Breakdown: interactive MRR -0.4% p95 +30ms; batch-long MRR -3.8% p95 +420ms.

sam: batch-long is the outlier. those runs soak the GPUs. we need per-bucket inflight caps and an eviction clamp for long-running requests.

rachel: propose thermostat rules: dynamic clamp when overall GPU utilization > 78% and long p95 > baseline+180ms => reduce long allocation to 0 and trigger fallback. also keep a soft-decay to avoid flapping.

li: current default config in staging:
```json
{
  "allocation_pct": 1.5,
  "buckets": {
    "interactive": {"pct": 1.0, "max_inflight": 160},
    "batch": {"pct": 0.5, "max_inflight": 20, "long_pct": 0.1}
  },
  "fallback": {"mrr_drop_pct": 1.2, "hallucination_pp": 0.4, "window_mins": 10},
  "thermostat": {"gpu_util_threshold": 0.78, "latency_delta_ms": 180}
}
```

sam: want to tighten for batch.long: set batch.max_inflight=8 and batch.long_pct=0.02. add min_sample_floor=120 for any auto-decision.

rachel: add a two-tier rollback: soft-fallback (clamp bucket to 0.1% and enable throttling) on first breach; hard-fallback (100% route to v3.2-fp16) if breach persists for 2 consecutive 10m windows. that gives hysteresis.

infra_bot: note: will attach incident alert when hard-fallback fires and create PD if hard-fallback occurs outside maintenance hours.

li: also request: seed KV warmup for batch.long during first 20 minutes to avoid cold-kv skew. add synthetic warmup traffic equal to 3% of bucket volume.

sam: suggestion: measurement normalization: compare long cohort p95 after trimming the top 1% slowest samples to avoid rare infra noise.

rachel: agree. also record tail-count (num requests > baseline+200ms) as a secondary metric for eviction logic.

li: updated gate I will push to staging now (applied):
```json
{
  "allocation_pct": 1.5,
  "buckets": {
    "interactive": {"pct": 1.0, "max_inflight": 160},
    "batch": {"pct": 0.5, "max_inflight": 8, "long_pct": 0.02}
  },
  "gates": {"global_mrr_drop_pct": 1.2, "bucket_mrr": {"batch_long": 0.7}, "min_samples_for_decision": 120, "required_consecutive_windows": 2, "window_minutes": 10},
  "thermostat": {"gpu_util_threshold": 0.78, "latency_delta_ms": 180, "tail_count_threshold": 50},
  "warmup": {"kv_seed_pct": 3, "duration_minutes": 20}
}
```

eval_bot: staging run started with updated gate (job 20250401-17). will stream coarse telemetry to dashboard and post snapshots.

sam: decision: hold wide promote. promote only if batch_long MRR delta >= -1.5% and batch_long p95 <= baseline+150ms for 2h sustained and hallucination < +0.3pp.

rachel: add quiet-burn: max increase 0.5% of allocation per 15m and require 3h stable period before any >5% bump.

li: action items: (1) push config and start 6h extended smoke w/ warmups, (2) wire incidents + PD for hard-fallback, (3) track trimmed-p95 + tail-count for decisions, (4) SRE watch 1st 60m. I'll post run snapshots at 30m and 2h.

li: thanks all, will update here when we have first dashboard snapshot. :rocket:
